```plaintext
# sleeping_dist.py
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image

def process_image(image_path):
    img = Image.open(image_path)
    pixels = np.array(img)
    # Perform some operations on the pixels
    # ...

    # Extract the flag from the image
    flag = ""
    for i in range(pixels.shape[0]):
        for j in range(pixels.shape[1]):
            if pixels[i, j, 0] & 0x80:
                flag += chr(pixels[i, j, 0] & 0x7F)
            else:
                continue
    return flag

if __name__ == "__main__":
    image_path = "flag.png"
    flag = process_image(image_path)
    print(flag)
```
